parameters.query: SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.email, c.phone, c.mobile, v.id AS vehicle_id, v.license_plate, COALESCE(bm.name, bm2.name, vm.name, vm2.name, cm.name, NULLIF(v.notes, '')) AS modelo, COALESCE(bvv.name, vv.name) AS version FROM customers c LEFT JOIN customer_vehicles v ON v.customer_id = c.id AND v.is_active = 1 LEFT JOIN brand_vehicle_models bm ON bm.id = v.brand_vehicle_model_id LEFT JOIN vehicle_models vm ON vm.id = v.vehicle_model_id LEFT JOIN brand_vehicle_versions bvv ON bvv.id = v.brand_vehicle_version_id LEFT JOIN brand_vehicle_models bm2 ON bm2.id = bvv.brand_vehicle_model_id LEFT JOIN vehicle_versions vv ON vv.id = v.vehicle_version_id LEFT JOIN vehicle_models vm2 ON vm2.id = vv.vehicle_model_id LEFT JOIN brand_vehicle_models cm ON cm.id = c.model_id WHERE c.client_id = $1 AND c.is_active = 1 AND (RIGHT(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(IFNULL(c.phone,''),'+',''),' ',''),'-',''),10) = $2 OR RIGHT(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(IFNULL(c.mobile,''),'+',''),' ',''),'-',''),10) = $3 OR REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(IFNULL(v.license_plate,'')),' ',''),'-','') = $4) ORDER BY c.id DESC, v.id DESC LIMIT 20
